data.title: Skyhills Residences
data.about:
Discover the Latest Apartments for Sale in Skyhill Residences: Skyhill Residences at Dubai Science Park is the groundbreaking property development by Hijazi Real Estate in Dubai. Nestled in the dynamic heart of Dubai Science Park, where innovation harmonizes with luxury, you'll find yourself amidst a breathtaking landscape along the prestigious Umm Suqeim Road. 

Be captivated as two iconic towers rise gracefully above the hills, revealing a sky-high masterpiece that redefines living, offering a lifestyle that soars beyond the clouds. Explore Skyhill Residences Apartments at Dubai Science Park, meticulously designed by QHC Architects & Engineers. This offplan property for sale in Dubai, boast a contemporary architectural style with an emphasis on spaciousness and functionality. 

Each unit is equipped with top-notch fittings, fixtures, and branded home appliances, ensuring ultimate comfort and convenience. With thoughtful floor plans catering to individuals, small families, and larger families, Skyhill Residences offers cozy and comfortable living spaces
